invariants: Synastry consumes two separately assembled natal chart snapshots; it does not merge or overwrite either person's natal state.
Cross-chart aspects are calculated from person-A placements against person-B placements with the shared explicit aspect/orb policy.
Both natal TT instants are retained in the comparison result.
Mismatched ephemeris source/version provenance fails closed.
Result ordering is deterministic and no device current time or network fallback is used.
